description: Allegro A4988 — stepper motor driver with built-in translator, up to 35V/2A, adjustable current control, microstepping down to 1/16 step. QFN-28 package.
name: a4988
watch_out_for: Needs current-limit set via REF (VREF divider/pot) and ROSC; microstep pins strapped; thermal pad vias required at >1A.
